title: Add network worker join blob flow
summary: Implement D1 from the network worker hardening plan by adding a secret-safe coordinator join blob and worker import flow.
reason: Worker setup should not require hand-copying a 64-character token and manually typing the coordinator URL.
behavior_before: A worker operator had to manually enter WorkerCoordinatorUrl and WorkerAuthToken, then configure path identity separately.
behavior_after: The coordinator can mint a one-time setup blob and a worker can import it to persist coordinator URL/auth settings and immediately run the existing connection/path verification flow.
